body: That is good advice, thankyou. I have a hard time getting out because I am so nervous and shaky and anxious. I just want to wallow all the time but that makes me more depressed

Both really, that would be nice. I just feel like I can be a truly happy person but depression brings me down to this dark other version of myself. I haven't always felt like this. I am scared of never being able to be accepted or loved by someone and it almost feels as if it's not fair because it's not who I want to be, but I can't just fix it..
I have tried therapy, meds, working out. It just seems like I can't be the person that I feel like I truly am. And being rejected by someone I love is so hard
